correctness.rationale: Known full-dimensional nested-tube fan provides exhaustive two-facet ridge compatibility. Projected incidence-vector Gram products yield every listed interior angle; binomial and 3-color counts yield its multiplicities and total; the conditioned multinomial CLT with gradient (9/8,9/8) and the arccos derivative give variance \(3/8\); the maximum follows by monotonicity and a balanced adjacent-size argument. Exact finite vertex-face affine rank checks passed in dimensions 2–5, and normal-angle and extremal formulas were independently checked as recorded. No finite experiment is used as a proof for all dimensions.

originality.rationale: The specified intrinsic-metric angular histogram, its nontrivial Gaussian second-order limit at \(2\pi/3\), and its sharp nearly-flat ridge extremes were not stated or logically supplied as metric theorems by inspected primary publications or nearest published records. Known tube combinatorics, facet normals and total ridge counts are explicitly credited, not claimed as original.
residual_risks: An unindexed calculation of the exact unit-simplex-sum star ridge angles or a general nestohedron metric-angle theorem may exist.

value.rationale: Complete multiplicity-resolved Euclidean curvature/angle information for the canonical star graph-associahedron is a natural geometric invariant beyond the f-vector. It exhibits strong concentration at \(2\pi/3\) with nontrivial Gaussian fluctuations, exponentially rare acute ridges and near-flat extremes with sharp parity-sensitive multiplicities; these contrasts motivate the precise computation and are not mere renaming or an arbitrary finite slice.
